literal: Of many tricks thief's humble words are they not our womanhood breaking weapon
translation: Are not the submissive words of that rogue of many tricks the very weapon that shatters my feminine reserve?
modern: பல மாயங்களைச் செய்யும் கள்வனாகிய என் காதலனின் பணிவான வார்த்தைகள் என்னுடைய பெண்மை என்னும் உறுதியை உடைக்கும் ஆயுதமாக இருக்கின்றன அல்லவா?
explanation: The heroine admits to her friend that she cannot maintain her feminine reserve and stay angry at her lover. She calls him a thief of many tricks because he knows exactly how to deceive her heart. His humble, pleading words act as a powerful weapon that effortlessly shatters her steadfastness and modesty.
